spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Struck, hurt, killed.
2

Destroyed.
3

Departed, lost.
4

Ended.
5

Deprived of, devoid of.
6

Disappointed.
7

Multiplied, (in arithmetic.)
n. (-तं)
1 Multiplication.
2 Hurting, killing.
E.
हन् to strike or hurt, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
A coward, a poltroon.
E.
हत slain, कन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bewildered, astounded, bereft of sense.
E.
हत, and चित mind.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Deprived of life or hope, overcome with despair.
n. (-तं)
Despair.
E.
हत, and जीवित living.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Cool after great heat.
E.
हत, and ताप heat.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Reduced to poverty.
E.
हत, and सम्पद property.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Fearless, free from fear.
E.
हत, and साध्वस fear.

m. (-न्थः)
Loss of sight.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
1 Cruel, merciless.
2 Desponding, despairing.
3 Vile, wicked.
4

Barren.
5

Weak, powerless.
E.
हत destroyed, and आशा hope, (in or by whom.)

mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं)
Having the horses killed.
E.
हत, and अश्व a horse.

mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः)
Debilitated, weak.
m. (-जाः)
A kind of fever, fever with debility.
E.
हत, and ओजस् vigour.

m. (-त्नुः)
1 Sickness, disease.
2 A weapon.
E.
हन् to kill or hurt, कत्नुच् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-त्या)
Killing, slaying, (used chiefly in composition, as ब्रह्महत्या the murder of a Brahman, रिपुहत्या killing an enemy.)
E.
हन् to kill, क्यप् aff., and न changed to त.

ind.
Having struck or killed.
E.
हन to hurt, &c., क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be abandoned, to be left.
E.
हा to abandon, तव्यर् aff.

n. (-त्रं)
Wages, hire.
E.
हन to hurt, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
